meta.title: Security and control · Mateos
meta.description: Where MateOS runs, what it can touch, what leaves your environment, who approves what, and what is logged. Built to Israel's Privacy Amendment 13.

h1:
A person
wherever
it’s needed.
hero.lead: Read-only by default. The questions a CTO asks on the second call, answered here.

cards.p: Read-only on your systems unless you decide otherwise, per system. No write access to your core system in a pilot.
Written down before we connect anything: which fields, to which service, for what.
A named person per process. Mate proposes, the person approves.
Every run, action, decision and rule change, with a date and a name.

before.title: Signed before the first line of code.
before.lead: Red lines, a stop rule and a success bar. Written by you, kept by us.

privacy.title: Built to Israel’s Privacy Amendment 13.
checks: A named responsible person on our side
privacy.doc: We document the data flows of each process before it goes live, and hand them to you.

quest.title: Security questionnaire?
quest.p: We answer it before the agreement is signed. Send it with the name of its owner on your side.

title: It’s your company.
Your move.
start.lead: Start with an X-ray: one day on site with the people who do the work, or one small agent. Every process ranked by payback. From $990.
